module_name: Financial Statement Forecasting in Equity Valuation

quiz.name: 2027 Equities - Module 8 Financial Statement Forecasting in Equity Valuation

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod8-Q1
entry.itemBody: An analyst is constructing a dividend valuation of a company and has assumed the following earnings per share (EPS) and dividend payout ratio for the next four years. Year EPS Payout Ratio (%) 0 4.00 40 1 4.60 40 2 5.29 40 3 5.819 60 4 6.10995 80 The analyst’s table above reflects a disaggregated model in which of the following years?

choices.itemBody: C. Years 3 and 4 Feedback C is correct. Choice C is correct because the increase in assumed dividend payout ratio for Years 3 and 4 causes assumed dividends per share to grow more rapidly than EPS during those two years. Choice A is incorrect because the dividend payout ratio remains at 40% for both years, so EPS and dividends per share are assumed to grow at the same rate in those two years. Choice B is incorrect because the dividend payout ratio remains at 40% in Year 2 before increasing in Year 3. As a result, EPS and dividends per share grow at the same rate in Year 2.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod8-Q2
entry.itemBody: An analyst is forecasting selling, general, and administrative (SG&A) expenses for a company for next year. She estimates a regression of the annual percentage change in SG&A (y-variable) on annual percentage change in sales (x-variable) using the last 20 years of the company’s income statement information. The analyst’s regression produces the following output: Coefficients Standard Error t-Statistic Intercept −0.008 0.011 2.00 % Δ Sales 1.15 0.115 10.00 Which one of the following statements is most correct about the analyst’s forecast of the company’s SG&A expense for the next year if she utilizes the regression results?

choices.itemBody: A. The analyst forecasts that SG&A expense will grow by more than sales in the coming year regardless of the sales forecast.
B. The analyst forecasts that SG&A expense will grow by less than sales in the coming year in the event of a 10% increase in sales.
C. The analyst forecasts that SG&A expense will grow by less than sales in the coming year in the event of a 5% increase in sales.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod8-Q3
entry.itemBody: An analyst has created an income statement and balance sheet forecast for PT Indorinjani, an Indonesian manufacturer. The following table shows a simplified version of the company’s balance sheet (in IDR thousands). Year t Year t+1 Non-cash assets 122,000 130,540 Non-debt liabilities 133,000 136,010 The analyst forecasts that PT Indorinjani’s net income (in thousands) for the next year (t+1) is 6,440 and that the company is expected to pay 50% of its net income as dividends. Which one of the following most closely states PT Indorinjani’s financing needs for next year and its FCFE if the financing needs are met entirely by using surplus cash?

choices.itemBody: A. Financing needs are 2,310, and FCFE is 910.
B. Financing needs are −910, and FCFE is 910.
C. Financing needs are 2,310, and FCFE is 3,220.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod8-Q4
entry.itemBody: Which of the following statements best describes the characteristics of a start-up company valuation?

choices.itemBody: A. Start-up company valuation models focus on the first-year cash flow forecast, with less importance assigned to the expected terminal value.
B. Start-up company valuation models forego a near-term cash flow forecast and primarily focus on the firm’s expected future terminal value.
C. Start-up company valuation models are usually based on a constant cash flow growth assumption plus a terminal value.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod8-Q5
entry.itemBody: Which of the following statements best describes the key features of a disaggregated model for a growth company?

choices.itemBody: A. Key equity value drivers in the growth phase include detailed revenue and profit projections to achieve targeted financial results.
B. Key equity value drivers in the growth phase include the level of earnings and the stability of earnings.

C. Key equity value drivers in the growth phase include the assumption of a constant growth rate and its use in estimating terminal value. Feedback A is correct. A is correct because growth companies focus on achieving scale and profitability over time via rapid growth. B is incorrect because growth firms often have low to no earnings and are seeking growth to achieve scale and targeted earnings over time. C is incorrect because growth firms typically are not expected to expand at a constant rate.

entry.title: 2027 Equities Mod8-Q6
entry.itemBody: Which of the following statements best represents the process of how free cash flow metrics are estimated in a disaggregated forecast model for equity valuation purposes?

choices.itemBody: A. Income statement and balance sheet forecasts provide the necessary inputs required to compute forecasted free cash flow metrics.
B. Assumed cash flow growth rates provide the necessary inputs required to compute forecasted free cash flow metrics.

C. Historical financial statements provide the inputs required to compute forecasted free cash flow metrics. Feedback A is correct. A is correct because income statement and balance sheet forecasts provide the necessary inputs required to compute forecasted free cash flow metrics. B is incorrect because assumed cash flow growth rate inputs are used in present value models, not disaggregated forecast models. C is incorrect because while historical financial statements may form the basis for revenue, expense, and asset forecasts, they do not provide the inputs to compute free cash flow forecasts.
